fields.description: Selvara 3 is a four-bedroom villa neighbourhood within Grand Polo Club & Resort. Contemporary façades, muted materials and landscaped communal spaces define the setting. Its own launch collection comprises 138 villas, with four layout styles arranged over ground, first and second floors.

overview: Selvara 3's brochure combines clay and stone-toned façades with travertine, wood and textured interior finishes. The landscape programme extends beyond individual gardens to community parks, a pool terrace and a retail promenade. A central green area connects the wider development's polo fields, clubhouse and stables. These descriptions concern the proposed setting; a particular villa's view and access arrangements depend on its plot.
research.locationNote: The neighbourhood is in Grand Polo Club & Resort, Dubai. The brochure identifies Al Maktoum International Airport, Dubai Hills and Dubai Marina among its access destinations. Published journey times vary between the release documents; check an actual route from the selected villa rather than treating those minutes as guaranteed.
research.priceNote: The official page's current selection starts at AED 7,282,888. Its historical headline still says AED 6.4m, while the Selvara 3 launch fact sheet states AED 6.49m. These are different published references, not simultaneous offers. Confirm a dated unit quotation and availability.
research.paymentNote: The original schedule spreads 80% across booking and construction, with 20% on estimated completion. The final four construction instalments are linked to progress thresholds. Past dates are shown as launch terms; outstanding obligations must be recalculated for a current purchase.
research.handoverNote: May 2029 is the estimate in Selvara 3's own payment sheet and Property Finder. Completion, possession and contractual handover requirements should be confirmed directly before purchase.

facts.label: Launch collection and averages
facts.value: 138 four-bedroom villas. The launch sheet gives average BUA of 3,805 sq ft and an average plot of 3,718 sq ft. These averages do not describe every home or current inventory.

facts.label: Three-level living
facts.value: The A Style 1 drawing places a guest bedroom and living/dining space on the ground floor, three bedrooms on the first floor, and a roof lounge with bathroom and terraces on the second. Carport and terrace/balcony areas contribute to the published total.

facts.label: Availability needs a fresh check
facts.value: Property Finder carries a sold-out label while Emaar displays a priced selection. Neither is treated here as confirmation that a particular unit can be booked.

facts.label: Correct phase documents
facts.value: The linked copies are labelled Selvara 3. The official page's shared-name downloads returned Selvara 4 documents during this review and have not been used for phase-three sizes.
